title: Common successors in pointed quotient comma categories
statement: Let A and B be commutative local rings in one universe, let π:A → B be surjective, and let K and L be separable closures of their respective residue fields. Their A- and B-algebra structures factor through the residue fields as in [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. Let H be extension of scalars defined by the ring pushout, as in [lem-sbc-surjective-quotient-base-change]. Fix any B-algebra isomorphism c:H(K) ≅ L and the explicit pointed base-change functor F of [lem-sbc-pointed-etale-quotient-functor]. Fix a pointed etale B-algebra T. For any two objects X,Y of the category of arrows T → F(S), there exists an object Z of that category and morphisms X → Z and Y → Z.

source.place: Tag 05WS, lemma-quotient-strict-henselization; parent proof step 3; Tag 04GW, lemma-henselization-colimit, filteredness argument

proof.text: Apply pointedEtale_filtered to A,K and B,L. Choose a common source successor U for the sources of X,Y. The induced maps a,b:T -> F(U) admit a target equalizer h:F(U) -> V, since the target is filtered.

Apply the relative pointed morphism lift to h, giving W,k and e with F(k) followed by e equal to h. The arrow a followed by h and e inverse defines Z in the comma category. The two maps to U followed by k give arrows X -> Z and Y -> Z. The equations follow from the equalization and lift equations by functoriality and associativity.

lean.statement:
theorem pointedEtaleQuotient_comma_refinement
    (A K B L : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K] [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsScalarTower A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [Field L]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    [Algebra B L] [IsScalarTower B (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    (π : A →+* B) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (c : (quotientBaseChange π).obj (CommAlgCat.of A K) ≅ CommAlgCat.of B L)
    (T : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (fun X : Over (CommAlgCat.of B L) ↦ Etale B X.left))
    (X Y : StructuredArrow T (pointedEtaleBaseChange π c.hom)) :
    ∃ Z : StructuredArrow T (pointedEtaleBaseChange π c.hom),
      Nonempty (X ⟶ Z) ∧ Nonempty (Y ⟶ Z)
